article-meta.article-title: Archival Dispatch: 25 Master Broadcasts Dated Across Here's to Veterans, This I Believe, Ripley's Believe It or Not, and The Life of Mary Sothern
article-meta.kwd-group: Here's to Veterans, Stan Kenton, Woody Herman, This I Believe, Margaret Sanger, Dick Powell, Ripley's, Mary Sothern, Original Filenames

sec.title: Batch 32 Forensic Discoveries
sec.p: Batch 32 resolves 25 historical master recordings across four American radio institutions: 7 Veterans Administration master concert transcriptions of ***Here's to Veterans*** (featuring Stan Kenton, Woody Herman, Ray Anthony, and Merle Haggard), 8 philosophical personal statements from Edward R. Murrow's landmark ***This I Believe*** (featuring Margaret Sanger, actor Dick Powell, Lincoln scholar Benjamin P. Thomas, and philosopher Dr. Hu Shih), 6 syndicated editions of Robert L. Ripley's ***Believe It or Not*** (Fall 1947), and 4 episodes of Mutual's daytime serial ***The Life of Mary Sothern*** (May 1937).

sec.title: 1. *Here's to Veterans* — 1948–1972 VA Master Discs
sec.p: Recorded in cooperation with the American Federation of Musicians for US veterans:
